title: Waves lineup editor: e outside Waves shows no stray status; budgets 0 shows the default

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S83 relay later notes. openLineup is reached from the global key switch (internal/tui/model.go:393-394, lineup.go:33-35), so e on Overview, Questions, Roadmap or Decisions, or with help open, shows 'Wait for the plan before editing' or 'Tick the item before editing its lineup'. Also 'budgets*: 0 min' shows the raw override while the daemon applies the project default for 0.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/lineup.go` and `internal/tui/model.go`: return nil with no status unless the view is Waves; show the project default for a 0 budget.
- `internal/tui/lineup_test.go`: tests for both.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestLineupKeyIgnoredOutsideWaves: e on Overview, Questions, Roadmap, Decisions or with help open sets no status and opens nothing.
- TestLineupBudgetZeroShowsDefault: a 0 override draws the project default.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Write the tests first and watch them fail. 2. Guard openLineup on the Waves view. 3. Draw the default for a 0 budget. 4. Update golden views if they change.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- slicer check
- adj lint
